modelVersion.description: Version date for the static preview content model.

id.description: Stable content id for the resource.

audiences.description: Audience landing views that surface this resource. Closed set. A resource with no audiences tag is treated as recruiting-visible by default.

claimStatus.description: Claim status from the RITE research package's claim_status_legend. needs_confirmation material must not be published.

sourceNote.description: Optional human-readable note on where this resource's content came from.

lastVerified.description: ISO date this resource's content was last verified against source material.

reviewPolicy.note: Every entry requires recorded product-owner (or, in production, editor/administrator) sign-off before publication, per constitution principle III. Approval records for this and the prior feature were recorded during features 0003 and 0004's resource-review passes.

productionMapping.note: Static preview content only. In the future .NET API / SQLite model, each resource maps to a reviewed, editor-approved Resource entity with a many-to-many relation to an Audience lookup table carrying the same alumni/active/recruiting values. claimStatus, sourceNote, and lastVerified map to fields on that entity's verification record.
